source: 547 Source of Familiarity
target: 547 Fons Familiaritatis

source: 547 Source of Familiarity
target: 547 Fons Familiaritatis

source: “Is this related to the Celestial Master?”
target: „Num hoc ad Magister Caelestis attinet?“

source: Franca’s interest piqued.
target: Francæ studium excitatum est.

source: Confusion enveloped her.
target: Confusio eam involvit.

source: “In the Fourth Epoch Trier, what did you see or hear that we didn’t?”
target: „In quarta aetate Trier, quid vidistine aut audivistine quod nos non vidimus?“

source: Everyone had been together unless it was before they met, but Jenna should have been aware!
target: Omnes simul erant, nisi ante congressum, sed Jenna id scire debuit!

source: Without pausing for Lumian’s response, Franca contemplated for a moment and suggested, “Could it be the aftereffects of using the Eye of Truth?”
target: Sine mora pro responso Lumiani, Franca paulisper meditata est et proposuit: „Num sequela usus Oculi Veritatis sit?“

source: She recalled Lumian’s abnormal behavior during that time.
target: Illo tempore recordata est de insolitis moribus Lumiani.

source: “Yes, that’s right.”
target: „Ita, recte.“

source: Lumian nodded, pulled up a chair, and settled down.
target: Lumian annuit, sellam attulit, et consedit.

source: He described the collision of two rocks, sparks flying, and the ensuing blaze that engulfed dry leaves and withered branches, amid echoing voices chanting “Celestial Master.”
target: Descripsit collisionem duorum lapidum, scintillas volitantes, et ignem subsequens qui folia arida et ramos aridatos devoravit, inter voces resonantes quae „Magister Caelestis“ canebant.

source: The more Franca listened, the more her focus intensified.
target: Quo magis Franca auscultabat, eo magis intentio eius intensificabatur.

source: Uncharacteristically, she refrained from interrupting.
target: Inusitate, ipsa interrumpere non ausa est.

source: As she listened, her gaze gradually shifted, seemingly lost in reminiscence and distant thought.
target: Dum auscultabat, oculi eius paulatim versa erant, quasi in recollectione et longinqua cogitatione absorbi.

source: Once Lumian finished recounting, Franca remained motionless for what felt like an eternity, frozen like a mechanical doll paused mid‐action.
target: Postquam Lumian enarrationem finivit, Franca permansit immota, quod quasi aeternitate sensa esset, velut statua mechanica in medio actu congelata.

source: After several seconds, she abruptly straightened up, pinched her nose, and forced a smile.
target: Post paucos secundos, subito se erexit, nasum comprimens, et risum fingens ostendit.

source: “As anticipated, the Celestial Master is part of our world.
target: „Ut praevidebatur, Magister Caelestis pars mundi nostri est.

source: “The fragments of civilization you received bear a striking resemblance to some aspects of my country’s history, yet there are differences… Could it be the true history concealed beneath the surface?
target: Fragmenta civilizationis, quae accepisti, notabilem similitudinem ad quaedam partes historiae patriae meæ ostendunt, attamen differentiae adsunt… Num vera historia sub superficie abscondita sit?“

source: “The Celestial Master is attempting to interfere and breach into this world, wielding significant influence over the Mystery Pryer and Savant pathways, much like the way the Celestial Worthy affects Seers, Apprentices, and Marauders?
target: „Magister Caelestis conatur in hunc mundum penetrare atque intromittere, vim magnopere habens in semitis ‘Mystery Pryer’ et ‘Savant’, similiter ut ‘Celestial Worthy’ super Vates, Discipulos, et Praedones afficit?“

source: “Could the depravity among some of the monks in the Deep Valley Cloister and the peculiar state of the Hidden Sage be linked to the Celestial Master?”
target: „Num pravitas inter aliquos monachos in claustro Vallis Profundae et status peculiaris Sapiens Occulti ad Magister Caelestis coniungi possint?“

source: Franca’s thoughts crystallized as she spoke, her eyes sparkling like a serene lake.
target: Cogitationes Francæ crystallizatae sunt dum loquebatur, oculi eius quasi lacus serenus scintillantes.

source: “That’s my hunch too,” Lumian concurred with Franca.
target: „Id quoque mihi suspicor,“ Lumian cum Franca consensit.

source: Franca rose and paced, seemingly alone, contemplating how to follow this trail and unveil the truth behind the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society’s transmigration.
target: Franca surrexit et ambulabat solitaria, meditans quomodo hanc vestigium sequeretur et veritatem de translatione Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum detegeret.

source: After a few minutes, she muttered to herself, “The connection between the two worlds is stronger than I expected. It’s not just through the River Styx…
target: Post paucos minuta, sibi ipsi submurmuravit: „Coniunctio inter duos mundos fortior est quam exspectabam. Non solum per flumen Styx…“

source: “We should still be able to find many traces of the interaction between the two worlds…”
target: „Adhuc plurima vestigia interactionis inter duos mundos reperire debemus…“

source: Franca halted her pacing and fixed her gaze on Lumian.
target: Franca vestigia sua sistit et oculos in Lumiano fixavit.

source: “When we grow stronger and amass enough gold, I want you to summon Chen Tu again, the Armored Shadow. He should possess some insight into the Celestial Master.”
target: „Quando firmiores fiamus et satis aurum colligemus, volo ut Chen Tu iterum evocetur, Umbra Loricata; ille aliquam prudentiam de Magistre Caelesti habere debet.“

source: “Alright,” Lumian agreed.
target: „Bene,“ Lumian respondit.

source: Franca lapsed into silence once more, her mind retracing an unknown memory.
target: Franca iterum in silentium cecidit, mens eius memoriam ignotam revocans.

source: A few moments later, she produced four brass metal plates and handed them to Lumian.
target: Post aliquos momenta, quattuor laminas aeneas produxit et Lumiano tradidit.

source: “The Language Comprehension charms you wanted. The one with the most intricate patterns allows you to understand the languages of the Southern Continent. The others are for the ancient Feysac language family. The activation incantation is the word ‘knowledge’ in ancient Hermes.”
target: „Incantamenta Cognitionis Linguae, quae volebas. Illud, cum figuris intricatis ornatum, tibi sinit linguas Continenti Meridionali intellegere; cetera ad antiquam familiam linguae Feysac pertinent. Formula activationis est verbum ‚scientia‘ in antiquo Hermete.“

source: She and the Bear had completed the delivery through Madame Hela’s messenger. The other party proved quite efficient.
target: Ea et Ursus per nuntium Dominae Helae traditionem perfecerunt. Pars altera se admodum efficax exhibuit.

source: After Lumian handed Franca the money, he “teleported” out of Trier and back to Port Santa.
target: Postquam Lumian Francæ pecuniam tradidit, e Trier discessit et ad Portum Santa celeriter rediit.

source: In the hushed aftermath, Jenna cautiously opened the bedroom door and stuck her head out.
target: In silentio subsequente, Jenna cauta ostium cubiculi aperuit et caput extraxit.

source: “Has Lumian left?”
target: „Abiitne Lumian?“

source: “Yes,” Franca replied, her emotions subdued.
target: „Ita,“ Franca respondit, affectus eius temperati.

source: Jenna glanced at her but didn’t press for more information. Instead, she redirected the conversation to the stack of information related to the underground tomb.
target: Jenna eam intuebatur, sed non plura quaesivit; conversatiōnem autem ad congeriem informationum de sepulcro subterraneo redirigit.

source: Late at night.
target: Sero nocte.

source: Franca returned to her room.
target: Franca ad cubiculi suum rediit.

source: Glancing at the small analyzer, the accompanying typewriter, and the radio transceiver, she didn’t sit down to chat as usual. Instead, she climbed into bed.
target: Aspiciens parvum analysatorem, machinam scribendi consociatam, et radiophonem, non consedit ad colloquendum ut more solito; proinde in lectum se ascendit.

source: Sitting in the middle of the bed, leaning against the pillow, hugging her legs and curling up, Franca’s gaze unfocused on the crimson moon and stars outside the window.
target: In medio lecti sedens, contra pulvinar recubans, crura complectens et se convolvens, oculi Francæ in lunam rubram et stellas extra fenestram vacue spectabant.

source: Lumian’s words today plunged her into nostalgia, but the more her emotions fluctuated, the less she wanted to reveal vulnerability.
target: Verba Lumiani hodie eam in nostalgiam traxerunt, sed quo magis affectus eius fluctuant, eo minus voluit vulnerabilitatem ostendere.

source: She endured it, pretending to have recovered.
target: Id sustinuit, simulans se iam sanatum esse.

source: Only when solitude enveloped her, as the night fell silent and the seemingly eternal stars adorned the sky, did she shed her thick “armor” and sink deep into her emotions.
target: Solum cum solitudo eam amplectebatur, cum nox tacebat et stellæ quasi aeternæ caelum ornabantur, ipsa crassam „armuram“ abstulit et in affectus suos alte se cecidit.

source: After an indeterminate amount of time, Franca lowered her head, burying her face between her knees.
target: Post tempus indeterminatum, Franca caput inclinavit, faciem inter genua sua deponens.

source: That night, she delved into a multitude of dreams.
target: Illa nocte in multitudinem somniorum se immergit.

source: Broad shoulders carried her as a child, a touch of white hair at the temples, dishes not particularly delicious but always suited her tastes.
target: Umeri lati eam portabant in pueritia; capilli albi ad tempora apparuerunt, et fercula, non prorsus sapida sed semper gustui eius conveniebant.

source: Pure emotions of her youth, memories of being the “atmosphere livening machine,” and her “broadminded” self all danced in fragmented sequences…
target: Affectus puri iuventutis, memoriae ut „machina atmosphaeram vivificans“ atque imagines sui „amplem mentis“, omnes in particulis fragmentis saltabant…

source: As her two decades unfolded in her dreams, she unknowingly opened her eyes, feeling the coldness on her face.
target: Dum duo decennia eius in somniis evoluta erant, nesciente oculos aperuit, et frigorem in facie sentiuit.

source: Reluctant to move, she lingered in the moment.
target: Nolens movere, in illo momento manebat.

source: Suddenly, a recollection struck her.
target: Subito, recordatio eam percussit.

source: Back on the fourth level of the catacombs, she and Jenna had encountered a man who seemed strangely familiar.
target: In quarto gradu catacumbarum illa et Jenna viro convenerunt, qui mirabiliter familia videbatur.

source: Initially, she believed that the original owner of her body had encountered him.
target: Initio existimavit quod quondam possessor corporis eius eum convenisset.

source: Now, the reason for his familiarity became clear.
target: Nunc ratio huius familiaritatis manifesta facta est.

source: The man bore an uncanny resemblance to someone from her home country before transmigration!
target: Vir incredibilem similitudinem exhibebat ad aliquem ex patria eius ante transmigrationem!

source: Despite altering his appearance to thwart immediate recognition, Franca was now certain that his facial features differed from those she had encountered in this world.
target: Quamquam aspectum suum mutavit ut recognitioni impediret, Franca nunc certa erat eius lineamenta faciei ab illis, quae in hoc mundo convenissent, dissimilia esse.

source: Softer, less chiseled!
target: Mollior, minus sculptus!

source: With a mix of fear and excitement, Franca sat up and pondered, Could it be that, aside from us transmigrating souls, there are others who physically transmigrated? Or has someone mastered the ability to freely traverse between both worlds?
target: Cum timore et exsultatione mixtis, Franca surrexit et meditata est: „Num praeter animas nostras translatas, alii corpore migraverint? An aliquis facultatem adeptus est libere inter ambos mundos perambulandi?“

source: After breakfast, Lumian stepped into the master bedroom’s washroom and retrieved a low-level Language Comprehension charm from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Post ientaculum, Lumian in cubiculi domini balneum ingressus est, et ex sacco Viatoris incantamentum pro cognitione linguae humilis gradus eduxit.

source: “Knowledge,” he whispered in ancient Hermes.
target: „Scientia,“ susurravit in antiquo Hermete.

source: The brass-like charm ignited with bluish-green flames and swiftly vanished.
target: Incantamentum, quasi aeneum, flammas viride-caeruleas accendit et celeriter evanuit.

source: Instantly, Lumian felt an abnormal clarity in his mind, as if an avalanche of additional knowledge had flooded in, unveiling the structural origins and connections of numerous words.
target: Statim, Lumian in mente sua claritatem insolitam sensit, quasi avalanche scientiae additae irruisset, originem structurarum atque nexuum plurium verborum pandens.

source: Today’s agenda: a visit to the oldest fishing village, perhaps meeting the Governor of the Sea. Mastering Highlander in secret seemed imperative to avoid missing crucial clues!
target: Agenda huius diei: visita ad antiquissimum vicum piscatorium, fortasse conventus cum Gubernatore Maris. Peritiam in arte „Highlander“ secreto assequi videbatur necessarium, ne indicia vitalia amitterentur!

source: The charm’s effects would last for seven days.
target: Effectus incantamenti per septem dies manebunt.

source: Leaving the bedroom, Lumian took Ludwig and Lugano to 21 Saint Lana Street in a rental carriage, where they met Martha, the matriarch of the Paco family.
target: Ex cubiculi discessit, et Lumian Ludwig et Lugano ad numerum 21 viae Sanctae Lanae in curru conducto duxit, ubi Martha, matriarcha familiae Paco, convenit.

source: Martha didn’t look like she was in her sixties, with only faint wrinkles at the corners of her eyes, appearing more in her early fifties based on her eyes, nose, mouth, and brows. Her features retained a unique charm.
target: Martha non videbatur sexagenaria, cum solis levibus rugis in angulis oculorum; ex oculis, naso, ore, et superciliis potius quinquaginta annos insinuans, lineamenta eius venustate singulari ornata retinebant.

source: At that moment, the old lady with grayish-black hair and light-blue eyes wore a black, widow-like dress and a dark, old-styled bonnet.
target: Eo momento, vetula, capillis nigris cum griseis mixtis et oculis caeruleis, veste nigra quasi vidua induta, et pileo vetere obscuro ornata erat.

source: Pale-faced, she was supported by two young maids as they boarded a four-wheeled, four-seater carriage.
target: Facie pallida, a duabus iuvenibus ancillis sustentata erat, dum in currum quattuor rotarum quattuor-locorum conscenderentur.

source: “Monsieur Berry, I’ll be relying on you,” Rubió Paco nodded at Lumian beside the carriage.
target: „Domine Berry, in te confido,“ Rubió Paco Lumiano iuxta annuit.

source: He was to accompany his mother to Milo Village to meet the Governor of the Sea.
target: Ille matrem suam comitari debuit ad Vicum Milo, ut Gubernatorem Maris conveniret.

source: Lumian directed Ludwig to Giorgia.
target: Lumian Ludovici ad Giorgia direxit.

source: “Please keep an eye on him until I return from Milo Village.”
target: „Quaeso, eum observa, donec a Vico Milo redeam.“

source: Rubió translated this time.
target: Hac vice Rubió interpretatus est.

source: Giorgia smiled and replied, “Don’t worry, I’ll make sure there’s plenty of food.”
target: Giorgia subridens respondit: „Noli timere, curabo ut copia cibi sit.“

source: She had already realized that this boy had the appetite of two or three adults, but as the godson of a great adventurer, it was understandable that he was special.
target: Illa iam intellexerat puer hunc appetitum duorum vel trium adultorum habere, sed ut filius adoptivus magni audacis viatoris, id intellegendum erat: peculiaris esset.

source: Lumian wasn’t concerned about Ludwig’s treatment in the Paco household.
target: Lumian de modo tractandi Ludovici in domo Paco non anxius fuit.

source: He feigned his understanding of Highlander and waited for Lugano’s translation before saying, “A meal every two hours.”
target: Simulavit se arti „Highlander“ periti esse et translationem Lugani exspectavit, deinde dixit: „Cibus quot duabus horis.“

source: With that, he sat on the right side of the carriage driver and didn’t enter the carriage.
target: His dictis, in parte dextro gubernatoris currus sedebat, et currum non intravit.

source: Seeing this, Lugano had no choice but to choose the seat to the left of the carriage driver.
target: Videns hoc, Lugano nihil aliud potuit facere quam sedem ad partem sinistram gubernatoris eligere.

source: Before doing so, he diligently translated Lumian’s final instructions.
target: Ante hoc, diligenter Lumiani ultimas instructiones vertit.

source: Although he didn’t know what would happen if Ludwig starved, he felt that it wouldn’t be good, so he emphasized it twice.
target: Quamquam nesciebat quid eveniret si Ludovicus esuriret, sensit id non fore bonum, itaque bis hoc confirmavit.

source: As the carriage set off, Giorgia processed the translation.
target: Cum currus profectus est, Giorgia translationem processit.

source: “A meal every two hours? Two hours?”
target: „Cibus quot duabus horis? Duas horas?“

source: The Paco family’s carriage rolled along the grayish-white stone-paved street.
target: Currus familiae Paco per viam lapide stratum, cinereo-albo, volvebat.

source: Lumian leaned against the carriage wall, retracted his right leg, and stepped on the edge of the carriage driver’s seat.
target: Lumian in parietem currus recubuit, crus dextro retraxit, et ad limen sedis gubernatoris accessit.

source: Lugano glanced at him, feeling a bit uneasy.
target: Lugano eum intuebatur, paulo turbatus se sentiens.

source: A seasoned bounty hunter, Lugano sensed something awry in this seemingly ordinary mission that prompted Rubió to assist his employer in hiding in Milo Village.
target: Lugano, venator peritus mercedarius, sensit aliquid anomale in hac missione apparenter ordina, quae Rubió impellit ut dominum suum in Vico Milo celare curaret.

source: His heart raced as he observed armed pedestrians on the street, fearing an imminent attack from the crowd.
target: Cor eius celeriter pulsabat, dum pedestres armatos in via intuerebatur, metuens impetum imminens multitudinis.

source: Under the October sun still blazing in Port Santa, the streets, damp from the previous night’s heavy rain, hadn’t completely dried.
target: Sub sole Octobri adhuc ardente in Porto Santa, viae, ex imbre noctis præcedentis madidae, nondum plane siccatae erant.

source: Lugano yearned to reach Milo Village quickly.
target: Lugano vehementer cupiebat ad Vicum Milo celeriter pervenire.

source: Glancing at Lumian, he noticed that Lumian had narrowed his eyes.
target: Intuens Luminum, animadvertit eum oculos angustatos habere.

source: Lowering his straw hat, Lumian seemed to be peacefully napping, showing no signs of nervousness.
target: Strigi pileum deponens, Lumian tranquillo somno quiescere videbatur, nullas indicia perturbationis ostendens.

source: Phew… With a powerhouse like him around, there shouldn’t be a problem… Lugano silently reassured himself.
target: Phew… Cum tali viro potentissimo adesset, problema esse non debebat… Lugano tacite se consolatus est.

source: The carriage headed north, leaving Port Santa and reaching a village nestled against the Dariège mountain range, overlooking the azure sea.
target: Currus ad septentrionem se contulit, Portum Santa relinquens, et ad vicum, in montes Dariège adfixum, mare caeruleum intuens, pervenit.

source: Fishing boats set off, accompanied by the resonant singing and chirping of seabirds.
target: Navigia piscatoria profecti sunt, comitantur cantu resonante et stridore avium marinarum.

source: Milo Village’s buildings exuded a historic feel.
target: Aedificia Vici Milo sensum antiquitatis efferebant.

source: Brown, yellow, and beige stone-brick outer walls, blackened at the lower half, gave them character.
target: Muri exteriores ex lateribus lapideis brunneis, flavis et beige, in parte inferiori nigro fusis, indolem eis dederunt.

source: Though the wooden components had been replaced, weeds still clung.
target: Quamquam elementa lignea substituta erant, herbae adhuc haerebant.

source: A small cathedral belonging to Earth Mother stood near the mountain, and facing the fishing village dock was the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: Parva cathédralis, quae Matri Terrae pertinebat, iuxta montem stabat, et opposita ad pontem vici piscatorii, domus Gubernatoris Maris erat.

source: The four-story building, with a white backing and gray bricks, resembled a cathedral and a sacrificial ground more than a human residence.
target: Aedificium quattuor tabularum, cum albo subnixo et lateribus griseis, cathédrali et loco sacrificatorio magis simile erat quam domicilium humanum.

source: As they arrived safely at their destination, Lugano sighed in relief and jumped off the carriage.
target: Cum tuto pervenerent, Lugano leviter suspiravit et de curru exsalivit.

source: Two maids supported Madame Martha as they headed toward the Governor of the Sea’s building, accompanied by Rubió Paco.
target: Duae ancillae Dominae Marthæ eam sustentabant, dum iter faciebant ad aedificium Gubernatoris Maris, comitatae Rubió Paco.

source: Suddenly, Lugano heard his employer’s voice.
target: Subito, Lugano vocem patroni sui audivit.

source: “Take a look at what’s wrong with that old lady.”
target: „Aspice quid in illa vetula male sit.“

source: Uh… Lugano glanced at Lumian, who had appeared beside him, wearing a golden straw hat.
target: Heu… Lugano in Luminum intuebatur, qui iuxta eum apparuit, indutus pileo striga aureo.

source: He raised his hand and gently tapped his forehead, activating his Spirit Vision.
target: Manum levavit et frontem leniter percussit, spiritus visionem activans.

source: Observing Madame Martha’s back for a few seconds after she entered the Governor of the Sea’s residence, he frowned and said, “Most notably is the excessive loss of blood and weak vitality…”
target: Observans dorsum Dominae Marthæ per paucos secundos postquam in habitaculum Gubernatoris Maris intravit, rugam fecit et dixit: „Praecipue est sanguinis nimia amissio et debilis vitalitas…“

source: Lugano hesitated before concluding, “It doesn’t look like illness. It looks more like an injury.”
target: Lugano cunctatus est antequam concluderet, „Non videtur morbus. Magis videtur laesio.“
